response: Probability of at least one focal-species record in a sample of 10 target-group recording days, calculated by finite-population rarefaction. This is a standardized recording-distribution indicator, NOT true occupancy or confirmed colonization.
recording_day_unit: cell x provider x date; pooled observers; not complete lists or standardized visits
primary_accessible_domain: Within 500 km of a focal-species record cell from 2001-2014; fixed without later records. Sensitivity 250 and 1000 km if needed.
cell_filters: Unique WGSRPD center, no multiple intersected WGSRPD regions; baseline2011-2014 unclassified fraction <=0.05; predeclared 5282-cell forecast pool.
training: 2011-2014 predictors -> 2015-2018 response; both periods >=10 recording days for evaluable training rows
test: 2015-2018 predictors -> 2019-2022 response; baseline >=10 days for predictions; future >=10 days for scoring only; never filter training by future availability
forecast_features: Baseline occurrence indicator, baseline effort and observing-season distribution, geographic location, log distance to pre2015 records; baseline environment and within-baseline environmental trends; static contemporary host indicators. No realised future environment or future effort as predictors.
tuning: Fixed settings, no tuning against final holdout. Any later change must be labelled post-hoc sensitivity.
scoring: Species-equally-weighted MSE/MAE and per-species error. Compare against persistence. Also evaluate changes and initially unrecorded cells; never claim all zeros are absences.
generality: Separate temporal, held-species, and held-spatial-block evaluations. Spatial block membership must keep shared climate cells together; species IDs not predictors. Fit all preprocessing inside each training split.
uncertainty: Species and spatial clustering; bootstrap uncertainty in incremental test errors, not causal intervals.
historical_knowledge_limit: Current static host catalogue and retrospective2026 observation archive do not represent an actual forecast issued2018.
goal_status: Active; model execution, validations, figures, and results pending
